selection: Coarse 1-pass at 96/144/300; promote nominal Pareto points and points within 25% speed margin of domination; test adjacent DPI for promoted model-language configurations; confirm candidates with 3 repeats per page; repeat promotion until every frontier point is confirmed
limitations: Empirical frontier over evaluated grid; screened dominated points may have only one repeat. No confidence interval or guarantee about untested DPI/model combinations.
